$comment: Ceilings for every shipped wasm artifact, read by `cargo xtask size` against the cargo release build (before wasm-bindgen and wasm-opt). Shrink-only: a ceiling more than the headroom above its artifact fails until lowered with `cargo xtask size --update`; raising one is a hand edit, and its reason says why the growth is worth it.
